mass_production.ref_zh: 鲍德温与合作方在犹他州建厂生产

locations.place_label_zh: 美国犹他州（以盐湖城示意）

notes: 法国工程师 Mercadier 1891 年就为入耳式耳机申请过专利。之后的演进：1958 年密尔沃基的约翰·科斯推出第一副立体声耳机，1979 年随身听让轻便耳机普及，后来的入耳式耳塞、无线耳机都属于耳机的进化。
summary_zh: 1910 年，犹他州的纳撒尼尔·鲍德温为了在礼拜时听清布道，做出头戴式耳机原型；后来的立体声耳机、入耳式耳塞都是它的演进。
summary_en: In 1910, Nathaniel Baldwin of Utah built a headset prototype to hear sermons clearly during worship; stereo headphones and in-ear earbuds were later developments.
summary_ja: 1910年、ユタ州の Nathaniel Baldwin は礼拝中の説教が聞き取りにくかったことから、ヘッドセットの試作品を作った。その後、ステレオヘッドホンやカナル型イヤホンへと発展した。

image.alt_zh: 耳机架上的 AKG 头戴式耳机
image.alt_en: AKG over-ear headphones on a stand

notes_en: French engineer Mercadier had already applied for an in-ear headphone patent in 1891. Later developments included John Koss of Milwaukee’s first stereo headphones in 1958 and the Walkman’s popularization of lightweight headphones in 1979. Later in-ear earbuds and wireless headphones are further stages of headphone evolution.
